items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: I know him where. Miney John.

ctx.x: Clifford General. Clifford General. So you remember Freddie Landry? Sullivan Sprawl? You remember him?

Sure. All them fellas. What did he play, Sullivan? Sullivan. He tried to play clarinet. Mm-hmm. He wasn't much on it. And let's see. Well, Miney was from up around there. Miney was on this side of the river. They was from the other side of the river. Oh. Miney was, yeah, Miney. I know him where. Miney John.
Did he play with him much or was he? He was a good trumpet player. Miney was a good trumpet player. I didn't know he was.
